sources.title: Shahar Mendelson, Holger Rauhut, and Rachel Ward, Improved Bounds for Sparse Recovery from Subsampled Random Convolutions
sources.locator: Complete 39-page paper. §2.1 Definition 2.1 and Theorem 2.2, printed pp. 4–5.
sources.source_kind_detail: Full author-hosted research paper. Read the exact robust-NSP formula and recovery theorem statement; the paper calls the result standard and does not prove it.

contents.name: §2.1 Definition 2.1: lq-robust nullspace property
contents.detail: For q=2 this is the exact tail-l1/head-l2 inequality with all vectors and all supports of size at most s.

contents.name: §2.1 Theorem 2.2: best-term and noise recovery bounds
contents.detail: The paper states the stable recovery rates and constants but does not supply a proof; the local theorem proves the claims and the example substitutes exact data.
